mapper.sql: pk_id, id, tenant_id, people_id, plan_id, plan_version_id, task_code, title, category, frequency, time_slot, related_ref, enabled, sort_order, payload_json, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO care_plan_task( id, tenant_id, people_id, plan_id, plan_version_id, task_code, title, category, frequency, time_slot, related_ref, enabled, sort_order, payload_json, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{peopleId}, #{planId}, #{planVersionId}, #{taskCode}, #{title}, #{category}, #{frequency}, #{timeSlot}, #{relatedRef}, #{enabled}, #{sortOrder}, #{payloadJson}, #{isDeleted}, #{gmtCreated}, #{gmtModified}, #{gmtDeleted} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM care_plan_task WHERE plan_version_id = #{planVersionId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, gmt_created ASC

SELECT t.pk_id, t.id, t.tenant_id, t.people_id, t.plan_id, t.plan_version_id, t.task_code, t.title, t.category, t.frequency, t.time_slot, t.related_ref, t.enabled, t.sort_order, t.payload_json, t.is_deleted, t.gmt_created, t.gmt_modified, t.gmt_deleted FROM care_plan_task t INNER JOIN care_plan p ON p.id = t.plan_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.people_id = #{peopleId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.enabled = 1 AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.current_version_id = t.plan_version_id ORDER BY t.sort_order ASC, t.gmt_created ASC
